findingClass: scraper/config/field-manifest.json committed to a state that scripts/generate-field-manifest.mjs (built from docs/design/field-source-resolution.spec.mjs) would not itself produce — a hand edit, a stale generation from before a spec correction, or a generator bug silently drifting from the spec it claims to be generated from (item 3 slice S0b, OD-5 §7.6: 'the manifest is never hand-edited; the generator is the only writer; CI refuses drift').
failThreshold: scripts/ci/check-field-manifest-current.mjs exits 1 whenever `node scripts/generate-field-manifest.mjs --check` finds ANY byte difference between the committed manifest and the generator's fresh output — reported as a resolved-plan diff (field, IPO type, old ranked sources -> new ranked sources), never a bare JSON diff.
unverifiableWhen: n/a — this is a CI gate, not a nightly audit check; it either runs (every PR touching the gate job) or does not run at all.
note: IMPLEMENTED, not a spec-only placeholder: scripts/ci/check-field-manifest-current.mjs is wired into .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml's `gate` job (one step, item 3 slice S0b) and has a mutation-proof self-test (scripts/tests/check-field-manifest-current.test.mjs) that reproduces the 10 pre-existing hand-written rows exactly (minus two documented spec corrections — Moneycontrol's retirement and an SME_NSE/BSE exclusion, both already true on origin/main before this slice) and asserts a one-source mutation is caught. This runs in CI on every PR, not the nightly floor, so it stays in notCoveredByThisManifest per docs/reviews/detection-checks/_meta.json's schema note (that manifest classifies nightly-audit coverage; a PR-gate check is a different consumer, scripts/ci/require-detection-change.mjs's own registry, not scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs).
owner: Landed 2026-09-17, item 3 slice S0b. Consumer: the PR gate (`gate` job, .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml). Promotion note: this check protects the GENERATOR CONTRACT (committed file == generator output), not the CONTENT of any individual field's rank/capability — a spec change that resolves a field to a worse source than intended still passes this check as long as the manifest was regenerated; that class is caught by review of the resolved-plan diff this check prints, per OD-5 §7.6's 'a rank change is reviewed as a diff of the resolved plan' rule.
